justification: Both show low-relief zoomorphic heads in profile arranged partly in a repeated row across a tall vertical surface, and both use a schematic outline style with internal linear detailing. But A is a stack of separate animal figures (quadruped, birds, crouching creature) with no human presence, while B is a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress, beaded collar and flanking wing-like appendages — a wholly different subject and organising scheme.
